svg.desc: The query creates descendant closure D and chooses one seed per nonempty direct owner using representatives or HNSW upper-layer greedy navigation. Seed scoring does not mark first-touch. Offers mark objects, filter by scope, reuse cached scores or compute distance, and independently admit into q1 and q2. Candidate queues are popped by distance; each object expands only on its first pop. The keep sets are merged for top k.
svg.title: DQS query procedure with independent candidate and keep queues

path.aria-label: DQS：双准入通道，共享一次查询的候选展开
全 D 每个非空属性
本查询内后续重复调用返回
不算距离、不入队、不展开
已算种子分数直接复用
keep₁ 容量 ef；准入时同时写入 cand₁ 与 keep₁
keep₁ 最远项决定准入阈值
独立尝试；keep₂ 容量 ef₂
准入时同时写入 cand₂ 与 keep₂
首次展开才 offer 邻居；陈旧项仍可展开
扫描局部边与跨属性边
再次调用 offer，访问代号阻止重复打分
否：两 cand 都空，结束
无每属性堆；不跨查询复用结果
ef / ef₂ 限制 keep 容量，不是 cand 的硬容量或距离调用上限；q2.keep 同样参与最终结果。
